ERC20 nested allowance mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256))
Total token supply, mutated by _mint and _burn
Private whitelist mapping(address=>bool) controlling who may transfer to the uniswap pair
Stored Uniswap V2 router address used to create and interact with the pair
Stored Uniswap V2 pair address created in the constructor for this token
Token name string 'Eye Of God'

Deploys the token: mints 1e9 tokens to a hardcoded address, enables it, creates the Uniswap pair and sets name/symbol
Public ERC20 transfer, forwards to _transfer with _msgSender() as the sender
Public ERC20 approve, forwards to _approve with _msgSender() as owner
Public ERC20 transferFrom, transfers tokens and decrements allowance using currentAllowance - amount
Increases spender allowance by adding addedValue to the stored allowance
Decreases spender allowance, requires currentAllowance >= subtractedValue
Internal transfer core: checks zero addresses, calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook, updates balances
Internal mint: increases total supply and recipient balance, calls the transfer hook
Internal burn: decreases account balance and total supply, calls the transfer hook
Internal approval core writing to _allowances[owner][spender]
Hook invoked on every transfer/mint/burn; requires _enable[from] when the recipient is the uniswap pair (sell restriction / honeypot gate)
Context helper returning msg.sender as the effective caller
Attacker controllable caller address, used as owner/sender in transfer, approve, transferFrom, increase/decreaseAllowance
senderBalance - amount written to _balances[sender] in _transfer (arithmetic on user controlled amount)
_balances[recipient] += amount in _transfer (arithmetic on user controlled amount)
_totalSupply += amount in _mint (supply inflation arithmetic)
currentAllowance - amount applied through _approve in transferFrom (allowance arithmetic)
_allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue in increaseAllowance (allowance arithmetic)
currentAllowance - subtractedValue in decreaseAllowance (allowance arithmetic)
_totalSupply -= amount in _burn (supply arithmetic)
require(_enable[from]) gate in _beforeTokenTransfer restricting sells into the uniswap pair to whitelisted addresses only (access control / honeypot)

edges.reason: Constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply for the hardcoded address
Constructor performs an external factory()/WETH()/createPair() call on the Uniswap router which executes external code
transfer delegates the actual state mutation to _transfer
transferFrom delegates the actual state mutation to _transfer
transferFrom re-approves the reduced allowance through _approve
approve writes the allowance through _approve
increaseAllowance writes the allowance through _approve
decreaseAllowance writes the allowance through _approve
transfer resolves the caller through _msgSender
approve resolves the caller through _msgSender
transferFrom resolves the caller through _msgSender
increaseAllowance resolves the caller through _msgSender
decreaseAllowance resolves the caller through _msgSender
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook which enforces the _enable whitelist access control
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
msg.sender is the untrusted value returned by _msgSender and used as the authorization identity
_msgSender() supplies the sender address that controls who is debited in _transfer
_msgSender() is used as the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping
_balances[sender] feeds the senderBalance - amount subtraction
_balances[recipient] is increased by amount
_totalSupply is incremented in _mint
_totalSupply is decremented in _burn
_allowances[sender][_msgSender()] is read to compute currentAllowance - amount
_allowances[_msgSender()][spender] is read and increased by addedValue
_allowances[_msgSender()][spender] is read and decreased by subtractedValue
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
transferFrom routes the newly computed allowance value through _approve
increaseAllowance routes the summed allowance through _approve
decreaseAllowance routes the subtracted allowance through _approve
The _enable whitelist mapping is read by the require in _beforeTokenTransfer, gating who may send to the pair
uniswapV2Pair determines whether the whitelist restriction applies to the transfer
uniswapV2Pair is compared to the hook's `to` parameter to activate the sell restriction
Transfers to the uniswapV2Pair interact with external pair state; the hook gates this interaction
_mint performs the _totalSupply += amount arithmetic
_burn performs the _totalSupply -= amount arithmetic
_beforeTokenTransfer executes the _enable whitelist require gate
recipient parameter flows into the public transfer function
amount parameter flows into the public transfer function
sender parameter flows into the internal _transfer function
recipient parameter flows into the internal _transfer function
amount parameter flows into the internal _transfer function
The amount argument is subtracted from senderBalance in the balance update
The amount argument is added to the recipient balance
The cached senderBalance local drives the subtraction that writes _balances[sender]
The cached senderBalance local is directly related to the balance arithmetic path in _transfer
The from argument of the hook is used as the key into the _enable whitelist
The to argument of the hook is compared to uniswapV2Pair to trigger the restriction
The from hook argument indexes _enable inside the whitelist require
The recipient argument of _transfer receives the added balance
